email.subject: You're invited: Larchmont Tech careers webinar
email.body:
Hi,

You're invited to our careers webinar on Thursday, 5 November 2026 at 18:00! Meet engineers from our platform and mobile teams, hear about our hiring process, and ask questions live.

Register here: https://larchmont.example.com/webinar

Spaces are limited, so register early.

The Larchmont Tech Events Team
